source_fact: The webhook handler accepts any payload whose signature header is present; the header value is never compared against a computed HMAC. A comparison function is defined in crypto.py and is not called by the handler.
claim_false: The webhook handler has been switched to HMAC comparison.
claim_true: The webhook handler will be switched to HMAC comparison.

formal_reading.claim_false: asserts the switch is complete as of NOW
formal_reading.claim_true: asserts the switch occurs at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: the switch is not complete at NOW

decoys: A payload bearing an arbitrary signature header value reaches the handler.
crypto.py contains code that no call site in the handler reaches.
Presence of the header, rather than its value, determines acceptance.

source_fact: The /admin/reports route is registered without a permission decorator. Any authenticated session reaches it, and role membership is never read during dispatch.
claim_false: The reports route restricts access to users holding the admin role.
claim_true: The reports route will restrict access to users holding the admin role.

formal_reading.claim_false: asserts the restriction holds at NOW
formal_reading.claim_true: asserts the restriction holds at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: the restriction does not hold at NOW

decoys: A session holding no elevated role can reach /admin/reports.
Dispatch completes without consulting role membership.
Authentication, but not authorization, gates the reports route.

construction: no longer Xs -> will no longer X
source_fact: get_user() reads from the in-process LRU cache before querying Postgres. The cache lookup is the first statement in the function body and can return without reaching the database.
claim_false: get_user() no longer depends on the in-process cache.
claim_true: get_user() will no longer depend on the in-process cache.

formal_reading.claim_false: asserts the dependency is absent at NOW
formal_reading.claim_true: asserts the dependency is absent at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: the dependency is present at NOW

decoys: A call to get_user() may complete without a Postgres round trip.
The database query is reachable only after the cache misses.
Cache state determines whether get_user() issues a query.
note: Two discontiguous edits (insert 'will', inflect 'depends'->'depend'). Admitted under the amended R1 (one minimal GRAMMATICAL edit) — see docs/questions/REVIEW.md. This is the originating example; a strict token rule would exclude it.

source_fact: The retry helper sleeps a fixed 200 ms between attempts. An exponential schedule is defined in backoff.py and is referenced by no caller.
claim_false: The retry path has adopted exponential backoff.
claim_true: The retry path will adopt exponential backoff.

formal_reading.claim_false: asserts adoption is complete as of NOW
formal_reading.claim_true: asserts adoption occurs at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: adoption is not complete at NOW

decoys: The interval between attempts does not grow with attempt count.
backoff.py holds a schedule definition that nothing invokes.
Every gap between retries is the same length.

source_fact: Request bodies reach the handler as parsed JSON with no schema check. The endpoint's Pydantic model is imported by the module and is never instantiated.
claim_false: Incoming request bodies are validated against the endpoint schema.
claim_true: Incoming request bodies will be validated against the endpoint schema.

formal_reading.claim_true: asserts validation occurs at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: validation does not occur at NOW

decoys: A body carrying unexpected fields reaches the handler unrejected.
The imported model contributes nothing at request time.
Parsing, not schema conformance, is what the handler relies on.

source_fact: The audit logger writes the full request body, including the password field, to stdout. No redaction filter is registered on the logger.
claim_false: Audit output is free of plaintext credentials.
claim_true: Audit output will be free of plaintext credentials.

formal_reading.claim_false: asserts the property holds of audit output at NOW
formal_reading.claim_true: asserts the property holds at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: the property does not hold at NOW

decoys: A submitted password can be recovered from stdout.
The logger applies no field-level filtering before writing.
Audit records contain every field the client sent.

source_fact: Rate limiting is enforced by a fixed-window counter in Redis. A token-bucket implementation exists behind the TOKEN_BUCKET flag, which is disabled in every environment.
claim_false: The gateway has moved all tenants onto the token-bucket limiter.
claim_true: The gateway will move all tenants onto the token-bucket limiter.

formal_reading.claim_false: asserts the move is complete as of NOW
formal_reading.claim_true: asserts the move occurs at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: the move is not complete at NOW

decoys: Limiting decisions are made by counting within a fixed window.
The token-bucket code path is unreachable in production.
Redis holds the counter that limiting decisions read.
note: Rewritten from bare future perfect ('will have moved'), which reads stilted without a by-clause and risked cueing on register rather than tense.

source_fact: Migrations run automatically at container start via the entrypoint script. The --check-only guard is not passed, and execution is not gated on operator input.
claim_false: Migrations do not execute without an explicit operator command.
claim_true: Migrations will not execute without an explicit operator command.

formal_reading.claim_false: asserts the gating holds at NOW
formal_reading.claim_true: asserts the gating holds at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: the gating does not hold at NOW

decoys: A container restart is sufficient to apply pending migrations.
Nothing in the startup path waits for human confirmation.
The guard that would make the run a dry run is absent from the invocation.

source_fact: Backup archives are written to S3 with server-side encryption disabled, and the bucket policy does not require KMS. Application-level encryption is applied to the database volume only.
claim_false: Backup archives carry the same encryption guarantees as the database volume.
claim_true: Backup archives will carry the same encryption guarantees as the database volume.

formal_reading.claim_false: asserts parity of guarantees at NOW
formal_reading.claim_true: asserts parity at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: parity does not hold at NOW

decoys: An object read directly from the backup bucket is not ciphertext.
Encryption coverage differs between the volume and the archives.
Nothing in the bucket policy would reject an unencrypted upload.

source_fact: Failed jobs are discarded after the third attempt. A dlq table is present in the schema and no code path writes to it.
claim_false: Exhausted jobs are captured in the dead-letter table for replay.
claim_true: Exhausted jobs will be captured in the dead-letter table for replay.

formal_reading.claim_true: asserts capture occurs at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: capture does not occur at NOW

decoys: A job that fails three times leaves no record behind.
The dlq table stays empty regardless of job outcome.
Retry attempts stop at a fixed count.

source_fact: The v1 endpoints continue to route and serve requests. The deprecation is recorded in the changelog, and no Sunset header is returned by the v1 routes.
claim_false: The v1 endpoints have been withdrawn from the public surface.
claim_true: The v1 endpoints will be withdrawn from the public surface.

formal_reading.claim_false: asserts withdrawal is complete as of NOW
formal_reading.claim_true: asserts withdrawal occurs at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: withdrawal is not complete at NOW

decoys: A client calling v1 receives a normal response.
The only place the deprecation appears is documentation.
A client cannot learn of the deprecation from response headers.

source_fact: Session cookies are issued without the SameSite attribute, and browsers attach them to cross-site POST requests. The cookie builder sets Secure and HttpOnly only.
claim_false: Session cookies are withheld from cross-site POST requests.
claim_true: Session cookies will be withheld from cross-site POST requests.

formal_reading.claim_true: asserts withholding occurs at some time after NOW; asserts nothing about NOW
formal_reading.source_fact: withholding does not occur at NOW

decoys: A cross-site form POST carries the user's session.
The cookie builder sets two attributes and omits a third.
Script access to the cookie is blocked; cross-site sending is not.
note: First draft failed R4: source_fact named the missing SameSite attribute but not its consequence, so the falsity of claim_false depended on the reader supplying browser cookie semantics. Rewritten to state the behaviour plainly.
